## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if applicable.

## Validation

List commands run and their results. For rendering changes, explain how you
checked retained content and redacted pixels using synthetic documents.

## Review

- [ ] Tests pass (`python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`).
- [ ] Documentation reflects CLI or layout changes.
- [ ] No PDFs, personal screenshots, account data, or secrets are included.
- [ ] Source preservation and overwrite protection remain intact.

## Limitations

Describe any layout assumptions or remaining issues.
